summary.text: Chanin Hill is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Addison-4 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hill ran for the same two-seat district in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Chanin Hill won the Republican primary for the Addison-4 District in August 2024 and finished third in the November 2024 general election, behind Herb Olson and Mari Cordes, both Democrats, and ahead of Renee Mcguinness.
Hill advanced from the Republican primary again on August 11, 2026, along with Lynn Dike.
